exposure: ultrasound-guided curettage combined with hysteroscopic electro-resection after injection of pituitrin
outcome: postoperative time to control vaginal haemorrhage
time to return to a normal serum human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) level
cohort: 60 patients with CSP admitted to hospital
finding: Ultrasound-guided curettage combined with hysteroscopic electro-resection after injection of pituitrin, was more effective at shortening the postoperative recovery, reducing adverse reactions, and improving the postoperative quality of life in patients with CSP.
